name: Mind Flayer

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: It has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
special_abilities.desc: Spell ability is Intelligence, save DC 15, no components. At will: detect thoughts, levitate. Once per day each: dominate monster, plane shift (itself only).

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. A Medium or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 15) and stunned while the grapple lasts.

actions.name: Extract Brain
actions.desc: Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., against a humanoid it has grappled that is incapacitated. Hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage. A target reduced to 0 hit points this way dies as its brain is taken.

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: A 60-foot cone of psychic force. Each creature in it makes a DC 15 Intelligence save. On a failure it takes 22 (5d8) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and the stun ends on a success.
